data.narrative:
Crusoe Energy is a Series C–stage AI & Software company founded by Chase Lochmiller and Cully Cavness, currently valued at $10.0B+ post-money with $3.0B+ raised to date. The peer universe comprises one public comparable (Palantir) and eight private peers spanning same-sector and adjacent-stage companies, including Figure AI, Skild AI, Wayve, Physical Intelligence, and Black Forest Labs.

Two triangulation methods apply to this valuation. Stage-progression analysis, anchored to the $10.0B last post-money valuation, applies a typical 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier to imply $17.0B. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $8.6B, with a range from $3.2B (Black Forest Labs, Series B) to $39.0B (Figure AI, Series C). The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in stage, capital intensity, and market narrative across the AI infrastructure subset.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $7.3B to $19.6B, with a median of $12.8B. This range brackets the current $10.0B valuation near its lower quartile. Key uncertainties include whether Crusoe's operational metrics and path to profitability align with higher-valued Stage C peers like Figure AI, and the sensitivity of the peer median to stage-definition boundaries, where one Series D comp (Wayve) materially influences the midpoint.
